'''''Crimson Climb''''' is a young-adult novel written by [[E. K. Johnston]] about [[Qi'ra]] during her [[time]] with the criminal syndicate [[Crimson Dawn]], revealing more of her backstory.<ref name="Other Authors">{{Twitter|ek_johnston|status/1622724832960909314|[[E. K. Johnston]]|quote=Building off the excellent work of @raecarson and @mightymur, we'll get more of Qi'ra's backstory in CRIMSOM [''sic''] CLIMB this October.}}</ref> At San Diego Comic Con [[2023]], it was confirmed the book would cover about a [[Standard year|year]] and a half timespan, starting when Qi'ra was separated from [[Han Solo]] and ending directly before she first met [[Maul]].<ref name="Alex Tweet">{{Twitter|StarWarsExplain|status/1682486219283001344|Star Wars Explained|quote=.@ek_johnston says Crimson Climb covers about a year and a half, starting right after Qi’ra is separated from Han taking us up to the point where she is about to meet Maul for the first time.}}</ref> The book was published on [[October 10]], 2023.<ref name="Disney" />
